verdictEs: Trials Report cuando juegas Trials of Osiris con ambición flawless y quieres matchup analysis del fireteam enemigo en tiempo real. Destiny Tracker cuando quieres un panorama amplio de tus stats en todos los modos (Crucible, Gambit, PvE) con match history y leaderboards. La primera es profunda en un modo; la segunda es general en todo el juego.
verdictEn: Trials Report when you play Trials of Osiris with flawless ambition and want real-time matchup analysis of the enemy fireteam. Destiny Tracker when you want a broad overview of your stats across every mode (Crucible, Gambit, PvE) with match history and leaderboards. The former goes deep on one mode; the latter goes wide across the whole game.

useCases.labelEs: Analizar al fireteam enemigo antes de un round de Trials
useCases.labelEn: Analyze the enemy fireteam before a Trials round
useCases.reasonEs: Su matchup tool carga el historial del trio rival apenas el match empieza; Destiny Tracker no tiene esa integracion automatica por fireteam.
useCases.reasonEn: Its matchup tool loads the rival trio's history as soon as the match starts; Destiny Tracker has no automatic per-fireteam integration.

useCases.labelEs: Revisar tu K/D y match history en Crucible regular, Gambit e Iron Banner
useCases.labelEn: Review your K/D and match history across regular Crucible, Gambit, and Iron Banner
useCases.reasonEs: Cubre todos los modos con match history detallado y filtros; Trials Report solo cubre Trials of Osiris.
useCases.reasonEn: It covers every mode with detailed match history and filters; Trials Report only covers Trials of Osiris.

useCases.labelEs: Ver el meta de armas del fin de semana de Trials
useCases.labelEn: Check the weekend weapon meta in Trials
useCases.reasonEs: Filtra weapon usage especificamente por el modo Trials; Destiny Tracker muestra tendencias mas generales por modo y patch.
useCases.reasonEn: It filters weapon usage specifically by the Trials mode; Destiny Tracker shows broader trends by mode and patch.
